links.outcome: LLM ICD-10 and CPT coding accuracy against ground-truth correct codes
links.effect: All LLMs better predicted CPT codes (91.5% correct) than ICD-10 codes (23.9% correct); ChatGPT 3.5 less accurate for ICD-10 than ChatGPT 4.0 or Gemini (P<0.0001).
links.quote: All LLMs better predicted CPT codes (91.5% correct) than ICD-10 codes (23.9% correct).

links.outcome: LLM coding performance across note authors and prompt designs
links.effect: No differences by note author (P=0.09 ICD-10, P=0.48 CPT) or prompt type (P=0.27 ICD-10, P=0.62 CPT); laterality-emphasis prompts improved ICD-10 accuracy to 40%.
links.quote: No differences in LLM coding performance were observed between note authors ( P = 0.09 ICD-10, P = 0.48 CPT) or prompt types ( P = 0.27 ICD-10, P = 0.62 CPT).
